searchText: Working on writing up that spec document. I expect to have something to share in the next few hours. Had some ideas on how we might use BEP29 + DiscV5 to do generic data streams for data that exceeds the UDP packet size. Posted in <#682024484689149955> because it looks well suited to be a generic sub-protocol that could be used by multiple other sub-protocols. Does BEP29 provide reliability/etc? As in, handling for lost packets? Yep Yes, there is an Ack mechanism that facilitates re-sending lost packets still griefable, but on par with TCP since it has that mechanism. I *think* that such a protocol *could* also be used for gossip. worth exploring the idea since eliminating libp2p from the stack would be a nice simplification. Ok. I've just opened https://github.com/ethereum/stateless-ethereum-specs/pull/54 which contains a really rough draft that I'll likely keep futzing with for the rest of today. Feel free to leave comments on the diff.
